name: n8n workflow diagnosis and repair dataset
provenance: Original synthetic diagnostic cases authored for this project. No customer workflows, secrets, or copied production exports.
format: JSONL chat messages: system, user, assistant

design.training: Fixable and abstention cases across expressions, data mapping, item linking, node configuration, workflow structure, Code node output, external API failures, and credentials.
design.validation: Separate synthetic cases for tuning and early stopping; do not merge into training.
design.evaluation: 50 held-out references including the original 10 baseline cases. Do not train on this split or iteratively hand-tune against it.
design.safety: Credentials and secrets are never patched. Ambiguous item-linking and external infrastructure/API failures require human review.
design.limits: Synthetic benchmark; not representative of all n8n failures. A structurally applicable JSON Patch does not prove runtime success. Some valid repairs may differ from the single gold patch.

validation.chat_schema: Each record has exactly system/user/assistant messages.
validation.unique_case_ids: All 300 records have unique case_id values.
validation.patch_application: All non-empty authored patches applied to their synthetic workflow fixtures.
validation.workflow_connections: All workflow connection source and target names validated after patches.
validation.credential_cases: All credential cases abstain with empty patches.
validation.secret_paths: No authored patch targets credentials or secrets.
